Aggregate.description:
Aggregation over the members of a group entity.

Required by household income (a sum over members) and by
household_has_elderly_or_disabled_member (an existential over members).
Aggregate.title: Aggregate

Arith.description: `subtract` and `divide` are left-folds over args, so `a - b - c` stays one node.
Arith.title: Arith

BoolOp.description:
Kleene conjunction/disjunction. Arity is n, not 2, so encoded law keeps the
shape of the clause it came from.
BoolOp.title: BoolOp

Clamp.description:
Bound a value. At least one of min/max is required.

Used on a parameter's lookup index for "for household sizes greater than six, the
standard deduction shall be equal to the standard deduction for a six-person
household" (273.9(d)(1)(i)).
Clamp.title: Clamp

ConvertPeriod.description: Period conversion is never implicit. Required by "divided by 12" at 273.9(a)(3).
ConvertPeriod.title: ConvertPeriod

Exception_.description:
A rule-local exception.

`disable_base_rule` suppresses the base rule. `substitute` replaces its effect —
the dominant legal form, as in "except that for a household with an elderly member
the limit is X". Encoding substitution as disable-plus-shadow-rule would duplicate
the condition and sever source correspondence.
Exception_.title: Exception_

Lit.description: A constant. Numbers arrive as Decimal, never binary float.
Lit.title: Lit

Param.description:
A dated parameter lookup, optionally dimensioned.

`args` maps a dimension name to the expression selecting along it, which is what
lets the standard deduction clamp its household_size index rather than its value.
Param.title: Param

Piecewise.description:
First matching case wins. `otherwise` is mandatory so a schedule can never fall
through to a silent unknown.
Piecewise.title: Piecewise

Ref.description: A reference to a variable by stable id.
Ref.title: Ref

Round.description:
Explicit rounding. There is no default mode and no default quantum, because
7 CFR 273.9(a)(3) rounds up and (d)(1) rounds up to the dollar — an implicit
rule would silently be wrong for one of them.
Round.title: Round

SourceSpan.description: Provenance. Every material semantic object carries at least one.
SourceSpan.title: SourceSpan
